title: RSH v4.0.0: Epistemic and Conformance Governance for Deterministic Robitaille–Slade Helix Evidence
description: RSH v4.0.0 adds RSH-EPISTEMIC-V1 and RSH-CONFORMANCE-V1: machine-readable evidence/claim classification, explicit runtime identity, no-silent-fallback rules, deterministic SHA-256 experiment receipts, and a sealed Python/Rust cross-runtime governance vector. The v3.0.0 Lean theorem surface RSH-FORMAL-V1, geometry model contract 2.0.0, tissue contract 1.0.0, and scientific authority hierarchy remain unchanged. GLUBALL integration is deliberately deferred to a later additive release.
